prototype.prompt: Create a visual UI prototype board with TWO full portrait Android phone screens side by side for original preschool puzzle games age5-6. Flat bright 2D toy illustration, cream, mint, pale blue, coral, warm yellow; very simple clean shapes, restrained outlines and a tiny short shadow, no photorealism, no elaborate textures or 3D plastic gloss, no licensed characters. Left phone: title 钢珠迷宫, level13, large portrait maze board with wide passages, mint walls and one normal silver-blue metal marble, golden star pickups, a green exit arch. Show one clearly ROTATABLE hinged orange board barrier, large circular pivot and curved rotation arrow at a T-junction. Draw a subtle dashed alternate vertical barrier position to show it can turn 90 degrees; avoid meaningless decorative gates. A large icon button below the board enters adjust-barriers mode, plus a tiny pause icon. Most screen real playable maze; no tutorial paragraphs. Right phone: title 数字碰碰, upper target badge large golden star with number5 and another badge with number4. Large 4x4 cream game board, rounded mint solid obstacles, candy-like flat square number tiles with bold perfectly legible large numbers1,2,3, two marked star goal cells showing5 and4. Clearly show one merging gesture with 2+3 becoming5, but keep this visual as a tiny transient floating feedback near tiles, not a permanent equation panel. Four oversized simple direction arrow buttons at bottom, undo and reset icons, no keyboard and no score/timer. Clear large typography, spacious mobile layout, child-friendly purposeful hierarchy. No subtitles, marketing, tutorial paragraphs, tiny explanatory text, photo shadows or imitation of known cartoon characters. All numbers max10. Original cheerful small leaf/star accents outside the boards only.

banner.prompt: A very wide 3:1 horizontal decorative banner asset for an original preschool mobile number puzzle named Number Bump. No text, NO DIGITS, no letters anywhere. Flat bright 2D vector-like children's toy illustration, very little shading and NO glossy plastic, no photorealism, cream and pale sky-blue background, mint leaves, simple round cheerful cloud, three large colored square toy blocks (coral, blue, butter yellow) gently bumping together at the center with 2 tiny star sparkles. Blocks have BLANK faces, the real game will overlay code-rendered numbers elsewhere. A little mint hill/cloud silhouette along bottom, a few soft leaf shapes at edges. Extremely simple broad color regions and crisp clean silhouettes suitable for age5-6, coherent with mint/cream toy labyrinth and silver blue marble art. Original artwork with no famous characters. Leave upper edge airy and restrained; only 5-7 elements total, no busy confetti, no educational equipment, no equations, no interface frame or buttons. Wide landscape panoramic composition, 3 times as wide as high.
